text: Cobalt Harbor performed an offline change assurance review for draft evidence log jsonl s002039 on 2026-07-14. The evidence question was: What minimal trace proves that the control remains attributable to its owner? The change sponsor assembled the source facts; the assurance analyst tested their ownership trace. The review relates AC-27 to evidence set 184 and records RISK-031 as the governing risk reference. Dependency context: no upstream dependency. The source record is p03-src-002039 and this artifact is p03-full-002039. The evidence instrument was the exception ageing report; the reviewer observed that the review preserved a clear separation of duties. During challenge, a duplicated statement was not accepted as independent corroboration. Review profile: the evidence set was collected during the follow-up review; the evidence custodian confirmed the record boundary; the reviewer sampled an adverse operating condition; the source fact supported acceptance without qualification; the comparison used the current control objective; the evidence was retained with the decision record; the exception path was considered and recorded; the reviewer assessed a handover impact; the decision was suitable for targeted follow-up; the source chronology contained a reconciled late entry; the control claim was corroborated by a compensating observation; the review boundary excluded unavailable material; the next assurance trigger is the scheduled review; the disposition was communicated to the owner; the retained rationale supports repeat review; the record remains a local offline assurance artifact. Counterexample considered: A complete-looking register is not reliable if the decision rule and disposition are absent. Decision rule: Preserve a bounded decision: cite the source, explain the rule, and state whether the result is accepted or escalated. Disposition: accepted with a retained review note. No Kio capability is used or required for this offline review.
